aboutText: B&D Concreting, based in Newport, Victoria, brings over 25 years of expertise in all aspects of concrete work. We specialise in domestic, industrial, and commercial projects, from driveways and slabs to exposed aggregate finishes. Our commitment to quality and customer service ensures reliable and durable results every time. Serving Melbourne and surrounding suburbs, we are your trusted concreting specialists.
servicesText: At B&D Concreting, we offer a comprehensive range of concreting services tailored to your needs. With 25 years of experience, our skilled team handles everything from plain and coloured concrete to complex foundations and repairs. We pride ourselves on delivering high-quality workmanship across Newport and greater Melbourne.

services.title: Concrete Driveways & Slabs
services.desc: Expertly crafted driveways and slabs that enhance both the curb appeal and functionality of your property.

services.title: Plain & Coloured Concrete
services.desc: Our team delivers durable plain concrete solutions and vibrant coloured options, adding style and reliability to your projects.

services.title: Exposed Aggregate Finishes
services.desc: Transform your surfaces with our exquisite exposed aggregate finishes, marrying aesthetic appeal with resilience for lasting beauty.

services.title: Footpaths & Crossovers
services.desc: Precision craftsmanship ensures safe and seamless pathways for pedestrians and vehicles, including footpaths, crossovers, and steps.

services.title: Foundations & Structural Work
services.desc: Build on a solid foundation with our dependable groundwork services, laying the groundwork for your project's success.

services.title: Commercial & Industrial Repairs
services.desc: Rely on our experienced team to restore functionality and integrity to commercial and industrial structures efficiently.
